entity_id_collision.title: VSSL entity shares its name with another integration
entity_id_collision.description:
The media player `{entity_id}` is being used by VSSL MX, but its natural name `{base_id}` belongs to **{platform}** (usually Google Cast, because the amplifier is also a Cast target).

Nothing is broken, but automations that address `{base_id}` control {platform}, not the amplifier.

To fix it, rename the VSSL entity in *Settings → Devices & services → Entities* (for example to `{base_id}_ma1`) and update any automation that used the old name. Version 0.2.0 gives new installs a model suffix so this does not happen again.
